metadata.identity: Haute Couture::The Crimson God of Le Rouge Sinclair
metadata.frame_convention: Zero-based decoded source frame; time_s = frame * 1001 / 30000. End frames exclusive. Native source is 29.970 fps, not exactly 30.
metadata.units: BH = visible standing body height of caster in same shot, excluding halo/cape spread. Distances are screen-plane estimates, not calibrated world coordinates.
metadata.precision: Native-window events identify individual frames. Other boundaries from 6/15 fps are explicitly approximate (usually +/-2 frames for 15 fps, +/-5 for 6 fps). Flash-obscured contact is bracketed; no invisible collision or coin boundary is asserted.
metadata.colors: Hex values are visual approximations under bloom/compression, not sampled material albedos.
metadata.mapping_policy: Supplied kit is the authority for names, Pierce type and coin counts. No skill-name/coin UI is readable; mapping confidence is separate from visual confidence. Repeated VFX pulses are not counted automatically as coins.
